name: verse-line-numbers
title: Verse Line Numbers
description: Poetry typesetting with margin line numbers every fifth line plus an active-line follower that brightens the number of the line currently in the viewport centre — scripture-style apparatus, live.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Asymmetric
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Viewport Line Follow: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
